items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: Frankie Jackson was in his highest bloom at that time.

ctx.x: too well on that. I wondered if it wasn't for Frankie Jackson and yet that would be too late for Frankie Jackson, wouldn't it?

No, that wouldn't be too late for Frankie Jackson because Frankie Jackson was in his highest bloom at that time. He was in his highest bloom at that time back there in the 30s. See, the old Cabin Inn was way before the 40s. See? And Frankie Jackson was in his highest bloom back there then. Oh.
All right. It might then have been enough. My memory gets a little weak too when I try to run back 20, 30 years.
